title: Lookup and selection
requirements: 10.01. `get()` validates its sequence argument as required.
10.02. `get()` returns the retained entry with the requested sequence.
10.04. `get()` returns `None` for a sequence never assigned or no longer retained.
10.06. `latest()` returns the newest retained entry for a non-empty journal.
10.07. `select()` returns only entries for which the predicate is true.
